- Keeps inline code text
- Inserts spaces between block elements (headings, paragraphs, list items, table cells)
- Truncates at word boundary with `" ..."` suffix when over `maxLength` (64 for API)

Test cases document behavior (`markdown_test.go:52–131`): headings flattened to text, code blocks removed, inline code kept, image alt text included, etc.

### D. `mentions` (extracted but **not** persisted)

`ExtractAll` collects `@username` tokens lowercased (`markdown.go:379–381`, `419`). They are **not** written to `memo.Payload`. Used only in `resolveMentionTargets` for inbox notifications (`memo_mention_helpers.go:32–43`).

---

## 3. What triggers recomputation

### Persisted payload (`tags` + `property`)

| Operation | Trigger | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| **CreateMemo** | Always, before DB insert | `memo_service.go:108–110` |
| **UpdateMemo** | Only when `update_mask` includes `"content"` | `memo_service.go:436–451` |
| **CreateMemoComment** | Indirectly — calls `CreateMemo`, which rebuilds payload | `memo_service_comments.go:56–59` → `memo_service.go:108` |
| **Batch rebuild** | `memopayload.RunOnce` | `runner.go:26–72` — utility only, not called from server/CLI |

**Does NOT** rebuild payload when updating only:
- `visibility`, `pinned`, `state`, `create_time`, `update_time`
- `location` (user-set; merged into existing payload at `memo_service.go:481–484`)
- `attachments`, `relations`

After create, user-provided `location` is applied **after** rebuild (`memo_service.go:111–113`), so it does not affect tag/property extraction.

### Snippet (recomputed on every read)

Any code path that converts a store memo to API `Memo` regenerates snippet from current content:
- `ListMemos`, `GetMemo`, `ListMemoComments` → `convertMemoFromStoreWithCreators` (`memo_service_converter.go:76–80`)
- Relations with snippets → `batchConvertMemoRelations(..., true)` (`memo_service_converter.go:224–229`)
- Inbox notifications → `memoNotificationSnippet` (`user_service_notifications.go:318–327`)

### Mentions (re-extracted on content change)

- After create: `dispatchMemoMentionNotificationsBestEffort` (`memo_service.go:171–173`)
- After content update: `memo_service.go:510–512`
- After comment create: `memo_service_comments.go:123`

---

## 4. Storage and filtering

Payload is stored as JSON in the `memo.payload` column (`store/db/sqlite/memo.go:17–26`).

Filter schema maps derived fields to JSON paths for list queries (`internal/filter/schema.go`):

```173:228:internal/filter/schema.go
		"tags": {
			Name:     "tags",
			Kind:     FieldKindJSONList,
			Column:   Column{Table: "memo", Name: "payload"},
			JSONPath: []string{"tags"},
		},
		"has_task_list": {
			JSONPath: []string{"property", "hasTaskList"},
		},
		"has_link": {
			JSONPath: []string{"property", "hasLink"},
		},
		"has_code": {
			JSONPath: []string{"property", "hasCode"},
		},
		"has_incomplete_tasks": {
			JSONPath: []string{"property", "hasIncompleteTasks"},
		},
```

User stats aggregate persisted tags and properties (`user_service_stats.go:137–154`).

---

## 5. Frontend usage (lists / previews)

The web app **does not** compute memo metadata client-side. It consumes API fields:

| Field | Frontend use |
|---|---|
| `memo.snippet` | Comment previews (`MemoCommentListView.tsx:45`), relation links (`MemoSnippetLink.tsx`), inbox messages, user map cards (`UserMemoMap.tsx:154`), sidebar relations (`MemoDetailSidebar.tsx:155`) |
| `memo.tags` | Sidebar tag list, blur-by-tag rules (`MemoView.tsx:blurred`), tag explorer counts from stats API |
| `memo.property.*` | Memo filters → CEL `has_link`, `has_task_list`, `has_code` (`useMemoFilters.ts:73–78`); shortcuts use `has_incomplete_tasks` (`Shortcuts.tsx:78`) |

List card layout uses raw `memo.content` for height estimation, not `snippet` (`memoCardHeight.ts:99–104`).

---

## 6. Related features that are **not** memo content-derived metadata

These are easy to confuse with payload extraction but are separate:

| Feature | What it is |
|---|---|
| **`GetLinkMetadata` / `LinkMetadataCard`** | Fetches Open Graph/HTML meta from external URLs at render time (`LinkMetadataCard.tsx`, `httpgetter/html_meta.go`) — not stored in memo payload |
| **`location`** | User-set via editor/API, stored in `payload.location` |
| **User/instance tag settings** | User-configured colors/blur rules for tag patterns — not extracted from content |
| **RSS item title** | Separate algorithm: first line of content, strip any `#` heading prefix, truncate to 100 chars (`rss.go:302–335`) — **not** the same as `property.title` |

---

## Summary

**Computed from content and persisted:** `tags` (5 fields in `property`: `has_link`, `has_task_list`, `has_code`, `has_incomplete_tasks`, `title`).

**Computed from content on every read (not stored):** `snippet` (64-char plain-text preview).

**Computed from content ephemerally (not stored):** `@mentions` for notifications.

**Rebuild triggers for persisted fields:** `CreateMemo`, `UpdateMemo` when `content` changes (including comments via `CreateMemoComment`), plus the unused batch utility `memopayload.RunOnce`.
